The '''Lornan implant''' regulated the body's electrical current, therefore it had the ability to protect the user's [[Brain/Legends|brain]] from energy surges caused by external electrical sources.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 14 or higher.
